pairs.registryProposal: The standard's waiver-names-its-finding technique should explicitly mention matching on git commit message trailers (e.g. `Gate-exemption: <rule> at <file>[:<line>] — <why>`) as a robust alternative to inline source suppression comments, preventing inadvertent proliferation of copy-pasted in-code disable directives.
